purpose: One resolution file per conflict: docs/battle-theatre/GOVERNANCE/conflicts/resolutions/C-0xx.json. It holds the PDF row and the first delegated default (quoted), every position (every value stays selectable), the weighing, the default (value, range, window or unresolved set), the class and tier, the plain-English source-panel text and the lists a reviewer and the integration step need. Read by tools/bt/conflicts/validate_resolution.py; the enumerations below are the ones that program uses.

class_meaning.settled: the better sources agree and every other value is explained by clock, rounding, place of observation, a different event or later memory
class_meaning.weighted: the evidence favours one value but does not settle it: a better-weighted value is the default, the others stay selectable with the reason they were not chosen
class_meaning.irreducible: the record itself is divided: the figure or time is a range, a window or a set of claims that stay side by side, with a declared basis
class_meaning.gap: no source settles the point: the list of failed searches is given; the default is a marked stand-in (plausible-procedural) or an open gap, never a filled-in guess

kind_values.period: {"text": "pre-dawn", "date": "1863-07-02", "part_of_day": "pre_dawn"} (a part of the day with no clock; the phrase must stand in the quote)
kind_values.count: {"n": 386} or {"parts": [400, 25]} (n is the sum of the parts); optional "unit"
kind_values.none: {"text": "no clock time in the sources"} (a statement about the record; never documented)

reason_meaning.clock: the other value is read on another clock (Union or Confederate time, local mean time) and the gap is that of the clocks
reason_meaning.rounding: the same moment, rounded or remembered to a different quarter or half hour
reason_meaning.tolerance: an 'about' or 'before' expression whose tolerance covers the default
reason_meaning.place_of_observation: another place or unit saw another moment (head or tail of a column, one battery)
reason_meaning.different_event: the value dates another act than the one the conflict is about
reason_meaning.later_memory: a reminiscence, outweighed by the record written at the time
reason_meaning.elsewhere: the writer was not there, or relays what he heard
reason_meaning.contradicted_by_primary: a primary source states otherwise (name it in weighing)
reason_meaning.outweighed: weaker sources overall: a lower class of writing, or fewer independent witnesses
reason_meaning.no_source: no source was found for this value (failed_lookups lists the lookups)
reason_meaning.lead_only: the value rests on a lead (web page, forum, aggregator) only
reason_meaning.unclear_expression: the expression cannot be read as a clock time or a figure
reason_meaning.equal_standing: irreducible: the value stays side by side with the default
reason_meaning.within_range: the value lies inside the declared range or window
reason_meaning.misprint: a demonstrable slip of the printed source

written_rank.official_report: 5 within 30 days of the event, 4 within 730 days, 3 after

citation_keys.page_or_note: page (the printed page as a string; for a `markers` text the PDF page index) or page = null with page_note
citation_keys.witness: {"name": who wrote it, "role": rank, office or unit, "side": union|confederate|civilian|other|institution}
citation_keys.states: {"times": ["HH:MM"], "numbers": [n], "dates": ["MM-DD"], "phrases": [text]}: what the quote states; every item is checked against the quote
citation_keys.exact: true when the quote states exactly the value of the position (needed for tier documented)
citation_keys.group: the line of knowledge the passage belongs to: two citations with the same group count as one source (a subordinate's report and the report that relays it share a group)
